currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture supports the open oval shell keep on a steep bounded motte, crenellated gatehouse/curtains and later residential castle. Retained east/south map controls set approximate scale, footprint and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply surrounding ground; architecture is raised6m to keep reconstructed courts above its coarse crest and bounded wall/motte toes reach it. The distinctive artificial motte is retained as landmark earthwork; broad surrounding hill/landscape is supplied by host terrain. Anchor -0.554513936,50.856706132; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 40.68276429976586m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
